title: SharePoint: AI citations analytics show how often Copilot cites documents, news and pages
summary: The roadmap facts, documented controls and carefully qualified licensing statements support publication. Narrow the assertion that the feature does not act on content to what the roadmap describes, and acknowledge Microsoft's differing names for the spending-policy automatic-coverage setting.

claims.claim: Existing SharePoint site usage data can be viewed by site admins, owners, members and visitors.

claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery is at SharePoint admin center > Sites > Active sites > site > Settings > Restrict content from Microsoft Copilot.
claims.quote: In the SharePoint admin center, expand Sites and select Active sites. Select the site you want to configure. Open the Settings tab, and then turn Restrict content from Microsoft Copilot on.

claims.claim: Set-SPOSite -Identity <site-url> -RestrictContentOrgWideSearch $true enables Restricted Content Discovery for a site.
claims.quote:
Enable Restricted Content Discovery for a site
Use PowerShell
Open PowerShell as an administrator and run the following command:
Set-SPOSite -Identity <site-url> -RestrictContentOrgWideSearch $true

claims.where: controls[1].governs and note; Risk assessment; Governance controls
claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery limits discovery of a site's content in organisation-wide search and Copilot discovery scenarios.
claims.quote: Restricted Content Discovery affects organization-wide search experiences (SharePoint home, Office.com, Bing) and Microsoft Copilot discovery scenarios, including experiences that rely on tenant-wide content discovery.

claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery does not affect experiences operating on content already in use, such as summarising an open document.
claims.quote: Restricted Content Discovery doesn't affect experiences that operate on content that's already in use by the user, such as summarizing an open document.

claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery hides the Copilot button and AI action entry points on the site.
claims.quote: Users don't see entry points such as the Copilot button, AI actions menus (including creating agents), or Create pages with AI.

claims.claim: Microsoft advises using Restricted Content Discovery selectively.
claims.quote: Use Restricted Content Discovery selectively. Excessive use can reduce the amount of content available to organization-wide search and Microsoft Copilot experiences

claims.claim: Microsoft describes Restricted Content Discovery as a temporary control while access and permissions are reviewed.
claims.quote: Restricted Content Discovery is designed as a temporary governance control that gives organizations time to review and right-size access while continuing their Copilot deployment.

claims.claim: Configuring Restricted Content Discovery requires an organisation licensed for Copilot with SharePoint Advanced Management available.
claims.quote: You can configure Restricted Content Discovery if your organization is licensed for Copilot and has SharePoint Advanced Management available.

claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery is not documented as a control over citation analytics itself.
claims.quote: Searched: "AI citations analytics" "Restricted Content Discovery". Opened Restrict discovery of SharePoint sites and content and Copilot in SharePoint setup; their stated reach is content discovery and AI entry points, not citation-analytics availability or audience.

claims.claim: By default only SharePoint administrators manage Restricted Content Discovery.
claims.quote: By default, only SharePoint administrators can manage Restricted Content Discovery.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -DelegateRestrictedContentDiscoverabilityManagement $true enables delegation of Restricted Content Discovery management.
claims.quote:
If you want site administrators to manage the setting for their own sites, enable delegation by using the following PowerShell command:
Set-SPOTenant -DelegateRestrictedContentDiscoverabilityManagement $true

claims.claim: Delegation lets site administrators manage Restricted Content Discovery for their own sites.
claims.quote: When delegation is enabled, site administrators can manage Restricted Content Discovery for their sites.
